cards.title: Meet Nutrition
cards.idea: One place in the real world where Nutrition quietly shows up.

interaction.prompt: Tap the part that looks unknown.

cards.reveal: The unknown is what we are hunting. Everything else is a clue.

cards.title: Feel the rule
cards.idea: The idea behaves like a balance: change one side, the other follows.

interaction.prompt: Drag the weight until it balances.

cards.reveal: Whatever you do to one side, you do to the other.

cards.title: Make a move
cards.idea: Undo one operation at a time to expose what is hidden.

interaction.prompt: Slide to peel one layer off.

cards.reveal: Each legal move keeps the answer set exactly the same.

cards.title: Predict, then check
cards.idea: A claimed answer must survive the original problem.

interaction.prompt: Type your value and test it.

cards.reveal: Substitute it back. If both sides agree, the answer stands.

cards.title: Where it bends
cards.idea: Every model of Nutrition has an edge where it stops working.

interaction.prompt: Push the setting to its extreme.

cards.reveal: Knowing where the rule breaks is part of knowing the rule.

workbook.prompt: What tells you a claimed answer is trustworthy?
options: it survives being tested against the original problem
it looks like the worked example
it was the first answer you found
workbook.answer: it survives being tested against the original problem

workbook.prompt: Pushing a rule to its extreme shows you…
options: where the ideal model stops matching reality
that the rule was never true
workbook.answer: where the ideal model stops matching reality

workbook.prompt: Before trusting a result, test it against the ________ problem.

boss.prompt: Which move is always legal while working a problem?
options: one that keeps the answer set exactly the same
one that makes the numbers smaller
one that removes the hardest part
boss.answer: one that keeps the answer set exactly the same

boss.prompt: You substitute your answer back and the two sides disagree. What does that mean?
options: the answer does not survive the original problem
the original problem must be wrong
substitution only works on easy problems
boss.answer: the answer does not survive the original problem

boss.prompt: Each legal move keeps the answer set exactly the ________.
